content.text: On Sunday, Nick Cassidy from Jaguar claimed victory in the race, while Jake Dennis from Andretti secured the second position, and Jean-Eric Vergne of DS Penske took third place.
Despite starting from pole position at Berlin's old Tempelhof airport, Pascal Wehrlein from Porsche, who was Rowland's nearest contender for the title, fell to 16th place in Sunday's race.
